entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: The youngest known plane in the Multiverse, formerly a militaristic kingdom on Jamuraa phased out to save it from the Phyrexians and which became its own plane after the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: The continent on Dominaria of which Zhalfir was a substantial portion.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A great mage and planeswalker, court mage of Zhalfir, who created the Creeds of Magic and phased Zhalfir out.

entities.name: Jolrael
entities.description: A great mage who made her home in Zhalfir's Mwonvuli Jungle.

entities.name: Queen Wezna
entities.description: Monarch of Zhalfir at the time of the Phyrexian Invasion and now.

entities.name: Queen Yormeba
entities.description: A girl of royal descent tutored and crowned by Teferi, who brought peace but failed to unify the nation.

entities.name: Mageta
entities.description: Current general of Zhalfir.

entities.name: Sidar Jabari
entities.description: Zhalfirin Sidar general whom Teferi reconnects with.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Intended Zhalfir to take the brunt of the Phyrexian attack.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: Planeswalker who explained how Teferi could unravel his spells and swapped Zhalfir with New Phyrexia using Realmbreaker.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: Artifact with which Wrenn bonded and swapped New Phyrexia's and Zhalfir's places.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Manipulated by Leshrac, used Radha as a mana lens to close the Zhalfirin rift.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: Manipulated Jeska into closing the Zhalfirin rift.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: Escaped his Amber Prison, as Teferi found.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: Plane swapped with Zhalfir.

entities.name: Koth of the Hammer
entities.description: Native planeswalker of Mirrodin, a sparkless refugee in Zhalfir.

entities.name: Melira Thrun
entities.description: One of fewer than twenty Mirran survivors in Zhalfir.

entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: Theocracy formed when southern Zhalfir split off.

entities.name: Ki'pamu
entities.description: Capital and royal city of Zhalfir.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The first Phyrexian invasion of Dominaria.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The later invasion in the aftermath of which Zhalfir became its own plane.

entities.name: Creeds of Magic
entities.description: The five Creeds of magic created by Teferi, each supplying a high wizard to the council.

events.summary: Teferi creates the Creeds of Magic, originally called Guilds, as his final act before departing Zhalfir.
events.quote: Teferi's final act before his departure was the creation of the Creeds of Magic, originally called Guilds.

events.summary: Teferi returns thirty years later to a continent near war, tutors Yormeba and crowns her queen, then leaves with advisors for the Chaza Isles.
events.quote: After crowning her as Queen Yormeba , she brought peace to the nation but failed to unify it.

events.summary: Teferi phases Zhalfir out of Dominaria to spare it from the Phyrexian assault.
events.quote: He phased out Zhalfir alongside parts of northwestern Jamuraa because he wanted to spare it from the horrors of the Phyrexian assault.

events.summary: Teferi returns three hundred years later and closes the Shivan rift by sacrificing his planeswalker spark.
events.quote: He managed to close the Shivan rift by sacrificing his planeswalker spark.

events.summary: Jeska, manipulated by Leshrac, forcefully closes the Zhalfirin rift, and the phased lands are lost to oblivion.
events.quote: the phased lands of Zhalfir were lost seemingly forever, cast into oblivion

events.summary: Wrenn explains to Teferi how he could unravel his spells and promises to help return Zhalfir.
events.quote: she explained how he could unravel his spells and promised to help him with returning Zhalfir

events.summary: Disconnected from the Temporal Anchor, Teferi ends up in Zhalfir, finds only a decade had passed and reconnects with Sidar Jabari and Queen Wezna.
events.quote: He reconnected with Sidar Jabari and Queen Wezna and found that Kaervek had escaped his Amber Prison .

events.summary: Wrenn and Realmbreaker swap New Phyrexia's and Zhalfir's places, making Zhalfir a plane of its own and bringing Mirrodin's suns to its sky.
events.quote: Wrenn and Realmbreaker swapped New Phyrexia's and Zhalfir's places in the Multiverse

events.summary: Mirran survivors are welcomed into Zhalfir as refugees through the Omenpath Wrenn opened.
events.quote: The survivors of Mirrodin have been welcomed into the new plane as refugees
